feedback_items.text: The new pricing page is confusing — I can't tell what's actually included in the Pro tier vs Team tier without clicking into three separate modals. We almost gave up and went with a competitor.
Onboarding wizard asked me the same question about team size twice in different wording. Also it wouldn't let me skip the Slack integration step even though we don't use Slack.
The dashboard takes 8 seconds to paint after login and that's on a fast connection. It's been like this for two weeks. Please fix.
Love the new dark mode! Way easier on the eyes during late-night incident response. One nit: the sidebar contrast is a little low in dark mode, hard to read inactive items.
I genuinely cannot figure out how to invite a teammate. There's an Add Member button on the team page but it just opens an empty modal with no fields. Probably a bug?
Honestly the Pro tier feels overpriced for what you get. $99/mo and we still can't get SSO without bumping to Enterprise. Every other tool we use throws SSO in at the Pro level now.
Project list view is super slow once you have more than ~50 projects. Filtering is laggy, sorting freezes for 2-3 seconds. We have 180 projects and it's becoming unworkable.
The signup flow is great — clean, fast, and I was creating my first project within a minute. Would recommend to other founders.
Tried to set up SAML SSO for our team. The docs say it's available on Enterprise only, but the pricing page shows it as a Pro feature. Which is it? Spent 40 minutes going back and forth with sales.
First-run experience is overwhelming. There are 12 menu items in the left nav before I've even created anything. A guided tour or empty-state hints would help a lot.
Reports page takes forever to generate anything beyond the last 7 days. We tried pulling a 90-day report and it just spun for 4 minutes before timing out.
The new keyboard shortcuts are fantastic, especially cmd+k for the command palette. Massive productivity boost. Please add one for switching workspaces too.
